definitions.explanation: the thin curved shape of the moon visible shortly after new moon or before the next new moon

examples.japanese: {夜|よる}{空|ぞら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{三日月|みかづき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かんでいた→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧。
examples.english: A crescent moon was floating in the night sky.

examples.japanese: {三日月|みかづき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦イヤリング→イヤリング：04684_iyaringu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought earrings shaped like a crescent moon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三日月|みかづき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{明|あか}るく→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いている→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: Tonight the crescent moon is shining very brightly.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧ (third day) + ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧ (moon) → the moon on the third day of the lunar month, which appears as a thin crescent.

MOON PHASES:
- ⟦{新月|しんげつ}→新月：17599_shingetsu⟧ (new moon)
- {三日月|みかづき} (crescent moon)
- ⟦{半月|はんげつ}→半月：08507_hangetsu⟧ (half moon)
- ⟦{満月|まんげつ}→満月：17598_mangetsu⟧ (full moon)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The crescent moon shape is common in Japanese design, from family crests (⟦{家紋|かもん}→家紋：15366_kamon⟧) to traditional crafts and modern accessories.
